justification: Both include schematic anthropomorphic imagery together with bird/animal imagery and simple geometric marking, with the most specific overlap being a human-like figure combined in the same object/field with avian or animal forms. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a frontal, vertically stacked human/creature figure, while B is a multi-register panel of mostly profile animals and signs with no comparable central frontal figure or perched-over-head relationship.
